g.text: A6 | dynamic integrator + independent regenerative latch
All MOS L = 30 nm; W in um. NMOS bulk = VSS, PMOS bulk = AVDD (three-terminal symbols).
DN / DP drive only MSIP / MSIN gates.
4 Clock / evaluation logic | standard gate symbols; physical devices below
CKF: front reset | CKL = CLKC AND CKD: latch evaluation | CKE = NOR(CKB, CKL): front-tail enable
5 Clock transistor implementation | same nets and devices as the functional view
Equal net labels connect across panels. Dots mark only real T / cross branches; unmarked crossings do not connect.
Drawing-only logic views do not add devices. All 40 MOS and 10 MOM instances are shown once at transistor level.
